title: Cambridge IELTS 20 Test 4 Writing Task 2
directions: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.
prompt:
How has global fashion become such a strong influence on people's lives?
Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
scenario: Many aspects of the way people dress today are influenced by global fashion trends.
requirements: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
